mission_08: Outstanding! You have implemented a dynamic GNN that captures both spatial and temporal patterns in evolving graphs. The GRU-style temporal update allows your model to maintain a running representation of the graph state while incorporating new structural information at each time step. The temporal attention mechanism adds the ability to focus on the most relevant historical snapshots, similar to how humans remember important events more vividly. This architecture is applicable to traffic forecasting, social network evolution, fraud detection in financial networks, and any domain where the graph structure changes over time.
